title: German Bank ING Deutschland Opens Retail Access to Crypto-Linked ETNs
text: ING Deutschland has opened retail access to cryptocurrency-linked exchange-traded notes (ETNs), allowing customers to gain exposure to Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana through its securities platform. Key Takeaways: ING Deutschland now offers retail investors bank-integrated ETNs for Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana. The products remove the need for wallets or private keys ...
